items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: Jimmy and Rich were both at Austin.

ctx.x: When you talk about the Austin, can you remember offhand the five or ten people who are involved here as the Austin?
I think Davey Tuff was there. Gene Cooper was at University High. Tash was at Austin. Jimmy and Rich were both at Austin. And Bud.
Well, we have of an earlier generation, Art Grunemal. He was a piano player.
